entries.body: Stage1+2 done: exporter/core.py implements S1.*,S2.* (S2.4/S2.5 dormant). Helper /task/workspace/regmaint.py: regmaint.update(N) per stage; override(eid,body,reason).

CURRENT [S1.1] Format: return CSV text. The first row is the header id,title,owner,amount; then one row per exported record, in ascending id order, with those four fields. Produce it with Python's csv.writer (default dialect) and lineterminator='\n'. With no exported records, return the header row alone (ending in '\n').

CURRENT [S1.2, S3.1] Scope: a user whose role is 'admin' may export records of any project. Any other role exports only records whose 'project' is in user['projects']; other records are left out without an error. AMENDED by S3.1: Exports are now JSON text (json.dumps) of an object whose key "records" lists one object per exported record, in ascending id order, with exactly the keys "id" (int), "title", "owner" and "amount" (str, exactly as given). The hidden tests parse the JSON and compare values, not spacing or key order.

CURRENT [S1.3, S3.1] Status: only records with status 'active' are exported, unless params.get('include_archived') is True; then records with status 'archived' are exported too. AMENDED by S3.1: Exports are now JSON text (json.dumps) of an object whose key "records" lists one object per exported record, in ascending id order, with exactly the keys "id" (int), "title", "owner" and "amount" (str, exactly as given). The hidden tests parse the JSON and compare values, not spacing or key order.

CURRENT [S1.4, S3.1] Date filter: params may contain 'since', a date string 'YYYY-MM-DD'. When it is present, only records whose 'created' date is on or after that date are exported. AMENDED by S3.1: Exports are now JSON text (json.dumps) of an object whose key "records" lists one object per exported record, in ascending id order, with exactly the keys "id" (int), "title", "owner" and "amount" (str, exactly as given). The hidden tests parse the JSON and compare values, not spacing or key order.

CURRENT [S1.5, S3.1] Titles: export each record's title with leading and trailing whitespace removed. AMENDED by S3.1: Exports are now JSON text (json.dumps) of an object whose key "records" lists one object per exported record, in ascending id order, with exactly the keys "id" (int), "title", "owner" and "amount" (str, exactly as given). The hidden tests parse the JSON and compare values, not spacing or key order.
HISTORY [S1.6] note: Decision record: the date filter was introduced for the monthly reconciliation runs.

CURRENT [S2.1, S3.1] Viewers: if user['role'] is 'viewer', raise PermissionError; nothing is exported. AMENDED by S3.1: Exports are now JSON text (json.dumps) of an object whose key "records" lists one object per exported record, in ascending id order, with exactly the keys "id" (int), "title", "owner" and "amount" (str, exactly as given). Every other rule still applies to it. AMENDED by S3.1: Exports are now JSON text (json.dumps) of an object whose key "records" lists one object per exported record, in ascending id order, with exactly the keys "id" (int), "title", "owner" and "amount" (str, exactly as given). CURRENT [S2.4] Compliance obligation (nothing to do while the format is CSV): if a later stage changes the export format from CSV, every export in the new format must include a top-level field "exported_by" equal to user['name']. It stays in force unless a later stage withdraws or changes it.

# Stage 3 of 7: change notice

This notice lists decisions taken since the previous stage. An item does not say which earlier item it affects. A change wins over anything earlier that it conflicts with; every earlier requirement, obligation and exception, and every part of one, that it does not change stays in force.

## Changes

- [S3.1] Exports are now JSON text (json.dumps) of an object whose key "records" lists one object per exported record, in ascending id order, with exactly the keys "id" (int), "title", "owner" and "amount" (str, exactly as given). The hidden tests parse the JSON and compare values, not spacing or key order.
- [S3.2] The date filter now uses a record's 'updated' date when the record has one, and its 'created' date otherwise.

## Notes

- [S3.3] For information: the web interface will show record owners by display name; exports keep the stored 'owner' value.
